scope: Development-only check of a specific opening for a calibration-aware range estimator: does a phase-dependent background with an optimally fitted hard cutoff explain event-age dependence? This does not establish a ranging benefit.
prior_information: The first million high-flux frames have already supplied counts, gap quantiles and cutoff incompatibilities. Their minimum gap and lower quantiles motivated this check. Published full-record fits are known. No range, phase/age exposure or hazard fit has been performed here. Both halves below are development data, not the reserved final validation sample.
comparison: Fit positive age-by-phase cell intensities on the chronological training half. Evaluate their continuous-time counting-process log score on the second half. Compare with the supremum hard-cutoff likelihood fitted directly to that evaluation half, allowing a separate background rate in each of eight phase strata. The cutoff supremum occurs at the smallest scored gap, clipped to the allowed interval. This is a stronger comparison than holding a wrong nominal cutoff or a training-only background fixed.
history_convention: Use every recorded detection to reset age, including detections outside the scored phase/age region. Condition on the first recorded event; do not infer the initial detector state. Retain the preceding event at the half boundary. Censor at the fixed one-million-frame boundary, which is inside the known acquisition. Define absolute time as frame*measured_period+detTime, then compute its phase modulo measured_period. Preserve the known out-of-period timestamp through this mapping; discard no event.
quantization: The analytic likelihood assumes exact continuous timestamps. Actual data have 8 ps resolution. Two deterministic alternating +/-8 ps perturbations are sensitivity checks, not an exhaustive uncertainty bound or an exact physical p-value. Do not convert a large log-score advantage into a physical confidence certificate.
gate: If the prefit age-dependent model exceeds the optimized hard model by more than log(100) on the evaluation half for all three timestamp scenarios, investigate whether recovery-aware ranging changes the decision and beats calibrated joint likelihood and robust one-step inference. Otherwise park this specific opening unless a new ordinary argument changes the comparison. This is a model-diagnostic gate, not the full user goal or evidence of new statistical methodology.
verification: Check exposure integrals against an independent interval-splitting implementation, phase partitions against their union, count partitions, frozen hashes, and the cutoff monotonicity calculation. Preserve failures. No data outcomes at or beyond frame 1000000, low-flux refit, pulse refit, Lean/Lake invocation, new hardware, outreach or publication.
